scope: Bounded native PDF placement of inline PNGs in ordinary, horizontally merged and nested table cells; measured source column proportions

checks.scope: Cell images, body pagination, affine rasters, PDF mapping/history/geometry/table diagnostics and HTML writer/table semantics; not full-project regression
checks.pre_fix_reproducer: Single 260pt-high cell image with no text exported successfully at y=24.75..284.75 although declared body ends at y=280; text guard cannot detect this
checks.layout_fix: Actual raster span/frame checked; body content-area guard; retry marker before whole outer table, never inside cell; repeated overflow refuses atomically
checks.column_fix: Measured grid-width ratios projected through actual row/column spans for PDF only; avoids collapsed nested column and neighbor overlap; default HTML cell styling unchanged
checks.image_fidelity: Own 120x180 RGBA program decoded pixels preserved exactly, crop/3-degree rotation visible frame retained, no overlap with words, caption and following text once, two JSON/PDF cycles with identical page pixels
checks.negative: Ordinary/horizontal-merged/nested table with oversized raster and no text refuses, preserves source Model and previous output; nested structure retained in negative test
checks.diagnostic: Explicit LOSS pdf-table-flow-layout: exact native row splitting/page pagination is not reproduced
checks.installed_pdf: Fresh Formats + Model 0.19.0 + PyMuPDF 1.28.2 only; nested table, crop/rotation, original RGBA pixels, complete text, two JSON/PDF cycles; Office/fontTools/Pillow/NumPy/other PDF engines absent
checks.visual_review: Independent Word source and generated nested-table image pages inspected; previous collapsed column/neighbor overlap removed; source pagination differs and is explicitly disclosed

owned_fixture.license: MIT; own geometric RGBA image, no third-party image content

boundary: Formats owns page/cell placement and Story projection; Model DTOs/codecs unchanged. Source width ratios are not exact native cell dimensions or margins. Source Word may split nested table rows across pages differently. Whole-table retry does not implement arbitrary row splitting or split a mixed text/multi-image paragraph. Unknown/unmeasured column grids retain existing automatic layout; universal Word-to-PDF fidelity is not claimed.
